loader.details: Initial full-screen white loader with bradyperron text and progress bar that animates to 100%, then hides with opacity transition

layout.header: none - minimal site, no traditional header. Bottom fixed bar only: left bradyperron name, right list/about buttons
layout.font: Acumin / Helvetica Neue / sans-serif - tracking tight, all lowercase bradyperron mark
layout.canvas: Full viewport canvas element for potential WebGL image trail — replica uses DOM infinite scroll + image preview layer to mimic

home_infinite_scroll.mechanism: Project titles duplicated 2x for infinite loop, vertical scroll with inertia, each row centered horizontally left-1/2 top-1/2 with translate, absolute positioning originally driven by WebGL scroll progress
home_infinite_scroll.interaction: Wheel / drag scroll advances list; hover on title reveals preview image behind with scale and opacity transition; titles have letter-spacing and font-size animation on proximity to center

titles: "I'll See You on the Other Side" Omar Al-Sudani x Office Mag
"Something in the Water" Jake Mageau x Level 1

bottom_bar.layout_name: Fixed bottom left, bg white/85 backdrop-blur-md, opacity 0 initially then fades in after loader, text bradyperron lowercase
bottom_bar.list_button: Bottom right 16 (64px left of edge) — toggles between infinite canvas view and plain list view

about_modal.trigger: Click about button, slides up from translateY(100%) to 0 with cubic-bezier, pointer-events auto, overflow-y auto

content.headline: Large fluid typography clamp 1.7rem to 3.75rem, 4.4vw, line-height 1.06, letter-spacing -0.018em, max-width 17em: Brady Perron is a Brooklyn-based Videographer/Director/Editor/Photographer. Rhythm. Range. Poetic. Dynamic.
content.image: Aspect 4/5, w-2/3 mobile, full md:col-4, portrait of Brady from Sanity CDN
content.contact: instagram and email with arrows ↗ and border-t, hover opacity 55%

animations.loader: Text slides up from top-100 opacity 0, progress bar width 0% to 100%
animations.titles: Each project-title-row has will-change transform, opacity, letter-spacing, font-size; transition letter-spacing 450ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1)
animations.about_words: Individual words wrapped in overflow-hidden with about-word inline-block that can be staggered via GSAP in original — replica uses framer-motion stagger
